comments.author: danans
comments.story: How did Ancient Greek music sound?
comments.why: Gilgamesh sung with a reconstructed oud.
comments.text: If you like this kind of stuff, you should listen to Peter Pringle singing the Epic of Gilgamesh while playing a reconstructed oud. While the melodies/rhythms he uses are his creation, the words are from the epic itself which was itself 2000 years old by the time of Ancient Greece. [VIDEO]
